additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0422409-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004171]Charger issue CRM:02681000143
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
We have analyzed the logs for the failed charging session and observed that the
EVReady state is 0
, whereas in the EcoG logs — when compared with a successful charging session on the same outlet — the
EVReady state should be 1
to process into the Cable check phase. Please find a couple of snapshots attached for your reference.
Multiple charging session got aborted after the Parameter Discovery check and it wont gone into the Cable check phase. Attaching the logs also for the reference.
Failed Charging Session
Successful Charging Session
In addition, there might be an issue with the
EcoG system and the liquid-cooled cable
, as some of the logs you shared indicate that the charging session was aborted. We need to investigate this in more detail, and if necessary, we should also check the EcoG firmware version currently running on the system.
Attaching the logs that you have shared & discuss over MS-Teams.
If required, we will involve the Expert Service Team for further analysis and assistance
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: Handover NOC-->Experts
additional_info.body:
Problem Description : Charging Issue
Action Performed (L2) : Logs analysis done, many charging session are getting aborted in the after the Parameter Discovery check, they are trying to charger eTruck(
eActros 600), the eTruck works fine in another Si-D at different location. Analysed the EcoG logs & found that the EVReady State is 0 and while comparing with the successful charging session on the same outlet, the EVReady state should be 1 for processing into the Cable check phase. Apart from it, there are some other errors found in the charger logs. In which there are multiple occasion in which the SSL handshaking is not being done, its related to EcoG and couple of more occasion that are linked to HPC charging cooling error. Attached the charger logs, EcoG logs and the word document which region has shared over MS-Teams.
Charger SW Version:
v6.1.3-0-gfb2eb75+meter-stop-HF
Reason for Handover (L3) : SLA case
Action Required
Action by HQ :
Deeper analysis need from the ES team in order to finding the root cause.
Attachement
: refer attched logs
